name: Smart Girls: Love Conundrum
source:
A crossover story featuring the characters from both the "Smart Girls" and the "Campus Hacker" books is out! Which heroine is going to win Ryan’s heart?!

[From official site]
translation:
《Smart Girls》与《Campus Hacker》的角色联袂登场，带来全新的联动故事！究竟哪位女主角能赢得瑞安的心？！

[摘自官方网站]
